projects.title: La Gerra
projects.summary: A residential block in the upper, quieter part of Suances, visualized from the street to the bedrooms.
projects.description: La Gerra is a residential block on the upper, quieter side of Suances, shown from the street, from above and from inside the homes.
projects.brief: A complete set of images to present La Gerra, a residential development in a secluded area of Suances: how the building sits on its plot, the communal pool and gardens, and what the homes feel like inside.
projects.approach: The exteriors show the building through its cantilevered volumes, warm cladding and planted terraces, from street level and from above. The communal pool and garden get their own views, since they are a selling point of the development. Inside, a calm, natural palette with daylight, green views and the sea on the horizon makes each home easy to picture lived in.

projects.title: Quinta Atlántica
projects.summary: A sea-facing residential development in Suances, visualized from the street entrance to the bedrooms.
projects.description: Quinta Atlántica is a residential development of low-rise blocks set into a sea-facing slope, visualized from its streets to its bedrooms.
projects.brief: A complete set of images to present Quinta Atlántica, a development of low-rise blocks in Suances: how it sits on its slope, the communal areas and what the homes feel like inside.
projects.approach: The exteriors read the project through its own materials: timber louvres, dark frames and glass against terraced gardens and the sea. Cameras look for the horizon between the blocks, and late-afternoon light gives depth to the façades. Inside, a warm and neutral palette with natural light and sea views makes the homes easy to imagine lived in.

projects.title: Novalinas
projects.summary: A residential development in the heart of Torrelavega, shown from its pedestrian square to the living room.
projects.description: Novalinas is a residential building in central Torrelavega, shown at street level, by night and from inside the home.
projects.brief: A set of images to present Novalinas, a new residential building in central Torrelavega, a few metres from the cathedral, between Novalinas and San Bartolomé streets: how it fits into the city, the public space around it and what the homes offer.
projects.approach: The views are taken at pedestrian height so the building is read as part of the street and the new square. The terracotta façades, black metal roofs and slatted balconies are shown in daylight and at dusk, when the lit windows and the square come to life. Inside, a bright, warm interior shows the homes lived in.

projects.title: Amura
projects.summary: A residential building in Santander, from the street to its rooftop terrace with sea views.
projects.description: Amura is a residential building in Santander, shown in exterior views, from street level to the rooftop terrace, and in an animation.
projects.brief: A set of exterior images and a video to present Amura, a new residential building in Santander: the building in its street, the entrance and garden, and the terrace at the top.
projects.approach: Warm late-afternoon light rakes across the pale panels and the dark ribbed cladding, so the angled balconies cast long, clean shadows. The views move from the whole volume to details at street level — entrance, garden, terrace — and end on the rooftop, where the sea opens up. The video carries the same light into motion.
